incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts on serving-cluster-7. Error rate spike from 0.8% -> 9.5% in last 5m. Paging on-call.
alice (oncall): ack paging, looking now. any customer-impact reports?
irene (customer-ops): seeing a few customer error pages, two enterprise tenants reported timeouts on chat endpoints. CS is collecting samples.
ben (sre): metrics look like scheduler queue depth skyrocketed for model-group=fasttext-v2. HOL blocking visible, long tail latencies on node gpu-3.
carla (prod-eng): is this an autoscale issue or batcher backlog?
dinesh (ml-runtime): stacktrace from the runtime shows continuous batching backlog + stalled KV cache writes. suspect head-of-line where one huge request blocks small ones.
alice (oncall): can we hotfix by enabling request-size-based routing to a slower model variant to bypass the big queries?
dinesh (ml-runtime): yes, we can route requests with token_count>2048 to model-slow-quantized and set fallback. Doing a quick config push now:```/ops/route set --model fasttext-v2 --rule "if token_count>2048 -> model-slow-quantized"```
deploy-bot: Deploy started by dinesh. changelist: route-rule-token-split. ETA ~45s.
ben (sre): also increasing batcher concurrency on cluster-7 to 8 -> 16 to try to clear backlog:```kubectl -n inference scale deployment batcher-cluster-7 --replicas=12```
dinesh (ml-runtime): scaling acknowledged. but HOL occurs at queue head even if concurrency increases because of request ordering. we need to enable fairness preemption on scheduler. I can flip a runtime flag: fairness_preempt=true for cluster-7.
carla (prod-eng): risks? will preemption drop in-flight tokens or break consistency for some API contracts?
dinesh (ml-runtime): preemption will checkpoint KV cache and resume; small risk for rare malformed sessions but acceptable for mitigation. flipping now.```/runtime/flag set fairness_preempt=true --cluster cluster-7```
alice (oncall): doing customer triage: which tenants affected? irene, send list to CS.
irene (customer-ops): sent to CS Slack DM. two high-usage tenants show 500s between 18:12-18:24 UTC. includes a payment flow. briefing to account reps sent.
ben (sre): metrics after route push + scale + preempt: queue depth down 60% in 2m, 5xx rate trending down but still at 3.2%. gateway timeouts reduced.
carla (prod-eng): nice. can we also add a short L7 rate-limit for large requests to avoid recurrence? e.g., max 2 concurrent >2k-token requests per tenant.
dinesh (ml-runtime): agreed. implementing per-tenant concurrency cap:```/policy add concurrency_limit --scope tenant --size_threshold 2000 --limit 2```
alice (oncall): who owns follow-up to remove the temporary routing and fine-tune batching policies? assigning to dinesh + carla.
dinesh (ml-runtime): will open a ticket and schedule post-incident changes: disable fairness flag after validation, tune batcher heuristics, and add unit tests for HOL scenarios.
ben (sre): quick note: we also saw increased 502 gateway errors from api-gateway-2 due to connection timeouts to cluster-7. temp mitigation: rotated gateway -> fallback route to cluster-3 for non-big-token traffic.```/gateway route add --from api-gateway-2 --to cluster-3 --filter "token_count<=2048"```
deploy-bot: Gateway route change applied by ben.
irene (customer-ops): any ETA for full service recovery? customers want an estimate.
alice (oncall): from current trends, aiming for recovered SLO within 20-25m. keep paging if errors >1% or new tenant reports.
carla (prod-eng): i'm going to kick off a short rolling restart of batcher pods on cluster-7 to clear any stuck loop state:```kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/batcher-cluster-7 --timeout=5m```
ben (sre): restarting now, watch for pod churn. also enabling elevated logging for blocked requests:```log-level=debug filter=query_size,hol```
dinesh (ml-runtime): preemption flag holding, route rules in place. we should be careful to monitor KV cache pressure; if it spikes we'll need to throttle.
alice (oncall): update: last 5m 5xx = 0.9%, timeouts decreasing, branch metrics show backlog cleared on most nodes.
irene (customer-ops): CS confirms two priority tenants still saw intermittent errors but overall traffic normalizing. Becca from enterprise A waiting on ETA for postmortem.
carla (prod-eng): creating incident ticket with timeline and tags: root cause suspected: scheduler head-of-line blocking from oversized requests causing batching saturation. mitigation steps: route large requests, enable preemption, scale batcher, restart pods, add per-tenant concurrency caps.
dinesh (ml-runtime): I'll own post-incident action items: tune scheduler fairness, add token_count-aware batching, and implement a circuit-breaker for oversized requests.
ben (sre): we should also add a dashboard alert for queue depth and HOL ratio so we get earlier paging next time.
alice (oncall): handoff time. ben, carla: you're on follow-ups. I'm un-paging. if errors spike again, paging will escalate to oncall-2.
ben (sre): got it, taking the follow-up. adding runbook updates.
carla (prod-eng): filing PRs for the routing rule to become permanent if tests pass.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: resolved -> monitoring. Severity: P1->P2. Postmortem owner: dinesh.
alice (oncall): thanks team. will mark incident resolved in 30m if no regression. :thumbsup:
